title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - InterruptionInstruction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/InterruptionInstruction. An instruction indicating an interruption to the process. Subclass of PPBCInstruction per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PPBCInstruction model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InterruptionInstruction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasInterruptionEndTime.description: Property. The end time included in an Interruption Instruction message indicating when the interruption should end.

hasInterruptionStartTime.description: Property. The start time included in an Interruption Instruction message indicating when the interruption should start.
